headline: Saudi Arabia Approves $371 Billion 2027 Budget With $51 Billion Deficit Forecast
summary: Saudi Arabia approved its 2027 national budget totaling $371 billion, forecasting a $51 billion deficit. Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman lowered non-oil economic growth estimates as public spending adjusts.
why: Saudi Arabia is the largest economy in the Middle East and the world's leading crude oil exporter.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: Saudi Arabia approved a $371 billion budget for 2027 with a projected $51 billion deficit.
